text:
You need a dependable virtual assistant who can handle structured, repetitive tasks carefully, keep things organized, and communicate clearly with clients while learning your systems quickly.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be a strong fit for this role because I’m comfortable working with precise information, following defined processes, and staying organized with deadlines. I have 6 years of experience in machine learning and Python-based work, and while my background is technical, the habits that matter most here are the same ones I bring to this kind of assistant work: accuracy, consistency, and clear communication.

A few past projects that show how I work:
- Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics: I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant that tracks parcels, reschedules deliveries, and hands off to a human with full context. Result: 43% of conversations were resolved without an agent, with a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5.
- Telecom churn prediction for a confidential client: I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read. Result: AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter, with 3.1x top-decile lift.

Those projects required careful handling of information, structured workflows, and reliable execution, which is exactly what your assistant role calls for. I’m comfortable learning tools you show me, entering data accurately, sorting information with judgment, and keeping processes moving without dropping details.

I also like the way you described the role: dedicated, loyal, on-time, organized, quick learner, strong in English. That matches how I work. I’m also open to writing emails in French if needed, and I can follow a clear process for client communication and album-related tasks once trained.

And for the laughing-to-tears story: one time I was so focused on a problem that I confidently explained a “bug” for several minutes before realizing I had never actually run the code I was talking about. It was one of those moments where I had to laugh at myself first, then fix the real issue. That kind of humility and attention to detail is part of how I work.

If you’re looking for someone who is steady, responsive, and easy to train, I’d love to help your business grow.
